leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Terminal `liveMacro.netMacroLift` at t = n-1 was injected into state initialization X_0[5] (t=0) and every historical bar t in [0..n-1] via `causalMacroLogForce`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Resolved `resolvePointInTimeMacroAt(candles[t].time, macroSeries)` inside the filter loop at t=0 and every bar t, and resolved origin macro at `candles[n-1].time`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Up to 4.82 USD trajectory shift when post-origin macro was perturbed.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Full-sample `cointegrationBasisMeanUsd` computed at t = n-1 was passed into historical bars t < n-1 for structural drift and multi-venue basis alignment.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Computed `causalBasisAtT = computeCointegrationBasis(c.close, candles.slice(max(0, t-29), t+1), causalBenchmarkUpToT)` inside the filter loop at each bar t.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Up to 2.15 USD residual/state shift under post-origin benchmark dislocation.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Two-sided `Math.abs(obsTime - c.time) <= tol` matched trade-flow, economic pulses, venue camera bars, and L2 order-book snapshots occurring up to +1800s AFTER bar t.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Replaced all two-sided `Math.abs` lookups with backward causal matching `obsTime <= c.time && c.time - obsTime <= tol`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Leaked post-origin L2 depth and economic pulses within +30m of origin.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Indexed `secondaryBenchmarkCandles` by array index `i` instead of causal timestamp `<= c.time`, and accepted pre-computed full-window `atr` and `htfPocAnchorPrice` scalars.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Filtered all auxiliary inputs to `<= originTimestampSec`, matched benchmark candles by timestamp `<= c.time`, and computed causal ATR and causal VWAP anchor from `candles[0..n-1]`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: External scalar perturbation shifted bands and equilibrium pull.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Two-sided `Math.abs(pt.timestampSec - barTimeSec) <= maxTol` leaked future funding/OI/basis up to +4 bars ahead, and fallback `return validLeverageSeries[validLeverageSeries.length - 1]` grabbed the terminal future observation.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Filtered `leverageSeries` and `chainSatellite` to `timestampSec <= originTimeSec`, enforced one-sided `pt.timestampSec <= barTimeSec`, and removed the terminal fallback.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Post-origin funding/basis shock mutated `state.leverageStress` at origin.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Normalized historical bar volume at step `i` by the full-window mean volume (`meanVol` over all 25 or 120 bars including bars > i).
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Replaced full-window `meanVol` with running prefix causal mean volume `runningVolSum / (i + 1)`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Future volume spikes altered historical EKF deltaTau and log-odds series.

leaksAuditedAndFixed.leakMechanism: Used unfiltered `secondaryBenchmark.candles` and `htfDailyCandles`, and used terminal `equilibriumPrice` and `compositeHtfPocAnchor` inside the historical precision-weight loop `k < n-1`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.fixApplied: Filtered `secondaryBenchmark.candles` and `htfDailyCandles` to `<= originTimeSec`, and computed local prefix `causalEqAtK` and `causalPocAtK` at each step `k`.
leaksAuditedAndFixed.perturbationMaxAbsDiffBeforeFixNote: Appending future benchmark/HTF bars altered precision weights at origin.
